items: MoSPI partnered with IDEAS Foundation and ISI Kolkata to develop desktop GDP Nowcasting software tool.
**Collaboration:** MoSPI + IDEAS Foundation + Indian Statistical Institute (ISI Kolkata).
**Deliverables:** Desktop-based GDP Nowcasting tool and harmonized health/nutrition NSS indicator framework.
≠ **Institute Name:** IDEAS (Institute of Data Engineering, Analytics and Science Foundation).
